courses.title: Elsa Workflows Fundamentals: Core
courses.summary: Get productive with Elsa Workflows 3.9.0 on your own: host Elsa in ASP.NET Core, build and publish Flowcharts in Elsa Studio, expose HTTP workflows and debug instances. Modules 0 to 5 with hands-on Labs A to C.

lessons.title: Module 0: Start here
lessons.preview_reason: Free taster: shows how the course works and gets the kit running, no paid lab content.

notes: Second preview suggestion: mental-model (Module 1), concept only, no kit needed.

courses.title: Elsa Workflows Fundamentals: Complete
courses.summary: The full Elsa Workflows 3.9.0 fundamentals path: everything in Core plus code-first workflows, control flow, bookmarks, testing and a capstone, with Labs A to H and the Securing an Elsa 3.9 host add-on (S1 to S4).
